features: 360 fisheye 1.19 mm fixed lens, 5MP sensor at 15 fps
Simultaneous panoramic overview and dewarped views
Metal housing with IP66 outdoor surface mount box (included)
dimensions_mm: 107 x 114 (H x dia, with outdoor SMB)
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NUC_52051_Data_sheet_enUS_18780709643.pdf, V15 2017). -F0E = outdoor version (metal housing, IP66 only with the included outdoor surface mount box); the indoor plastic version is NUC-52051-F0. 5MP sensor; used pixels in the optical circle 1792x1792 (3.2MP). Integrated microphone is indoor-model only. Camera alone 57 x 110 mm / 360 g.

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
